title: What's New: Boost Your Productivity with Business Central (2024 release wave 1)

chapters.title: Modern action bar made mandatory with enhancements
New copilot icon and opt-out options in action bar
New date picker control aligned with Microsoft products
Error sharing via Teams and email support
Help and support improvements and keyboard shortcuts

features.name: Worksheet access on mobile client
features.description: Access to worksheet pages from the mobile client with header details, line details, fact boxes and footer details visible. No more limitations on viewing worksheet pages.

features.name: Modern action bar made mandatory
features.description: The modern action bar, introduced three releases ago, is now made mandatory in 2024 release wave 1. Users will receive a call out explaining the changes with a link to a video.
caveats: Users can opt out individually via My Settings
Admins can disable for all users

features.name: Modern action bar enhancements
features.description: Minor improvements to the modern action bar including new copilot icon, spared captions to accommodate space, and optimized layout with flexible personalization and split button.

features.name: New date picker control
features.description: A new date picker control aligned with Microsoft products like Word and Excel, making it easier to explore and find dates far in the past or future.

features.name: Actions for platform-generated errors
features.description: Automatically generated navigate actions in platform-generated error messages for legacy code. Errors now have actionable items helping users navigate to pages where errors can be fixed.
caveats: Applies to legacy platform-generated errors with no additional developer effort required
Actions appear when user has permissions

features.name: Error sharing via Teams and email
features.description: Easy way to share error details via Teams or email to ask for help from colleagues, subject matter experts, or admins. Error details are automatically copied to clipboard.
caveats: For scenarios where user lacks permissions or needs help from another user

features.name: Help and support page improvements
features.description: Easy copying of tenant, environment, session and user details in the help and support page. Useful for users requesting external help and partners managing multiple customers.

features.name: Updated keyboard shortcuts PDFs
features.description: Updated keyboard shortcuts PDFs for productive users wanting to navigate with keyboard only.

features.name: Multiple file uploads
features.description: Feature planned for the April release that got postponed and is coming in one of the upcoming minor releases.
